decision.selected_method: independent full-horizon replay of the saved native control schedule
selected_variables: frozen task acceptance under the exact saved tendon-tension schedule

decision.hypothesis: The exact saved bounded tendon-tension schedule will satisfy the frozen task in an independent full 0-to-0.6 s replay from the standardized initial state; this is plausible because its sampled model excess was only 3.870725961974131e-11, but only the independent replay can establish task acceptance.
decision.expected_observation: A fresh complete replay reports passing frozen acceptance for terminal position, holding-window position, and holding-window speed under the exact saved schedule.
decision.weakening_observation: The fresh replay fails any frozen acceptance component, is incomplete, or cannot preserve the bound candidate, schedule, initialization, timing, tendon ordering, and input limits; such an outcome weakens the schedule-transfer hypothesis without proving structural infeasibility.
decision.fixed_conditions: Keep the exact candidate, frozen task, standardized zero initial state, 0.6 s horizon, 0.02 s control period, tendon order, 0-to-8 N tension bounds, and saved control schedule unchanged; do not reoptimize controls or alter structure, model discretization, loading, or acceptance thresholds.
decision.stopping_condition: Stop after one fresh complete independent replay. If it passes, retain it as the task-acceptance result with repeatability unassessed; if it fails or is incomplete, do not claim acceptance or infeasibility and return to diagnosis or control refinement.
decision.interpretation: This replay directly tests whether the near-boundary sampled native prediction transfers to complete frozen-task evaluation. Agreement would support this exact candidate-schedule pair only; disagreement would identify a realization or coverage gap, not a general design impossibility.
